sharedRules.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
sharedRules.description:
At the start of your Shooting phase, once per turn per model, if your Army Faction is THOUSAND SONS:
  - Attempt one of the Rituals below (each Ritual can be attempted once per turn across your army). To do so, take a Psychic test: roll 2D6, and you can roll one additional D6; if any two of its dice show the same result, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; if this model is not destroyed and the total of all its dice equals or exceeds the Ritual's Warp Charge, this model manifests that Ritual:
    - Destiny’s Ruin (Warp Charge 5): Select one enemy unit that is within 24" of this model and visible to this model (your Destinys Ruin Target); until the end of the phase, each time a friendly unit attacks it, unless the Psychic test result is 10+, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly models with the SCINTILLATING LEGIONS or THOUSAND SONS keyword; if the Psychic test result is 10+, you can re-roll Hit rolls for attacks made by friendly models with the SCINTILLATING LEGIONS or THOUSAND SONS keyword.
    - Temporal Surge (Warp Charge 6): Until the end of the turn, select one friendly unit with the SCINTILLATING LEGIONS or THOUSAND SONS keyword that is unengaged, within 24" of this model and visible to this model; unless the Psychic test result is 10+, that unit can make a Normal move of up to D6"; if the Psychic test result is 10+, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6"; that unit cannot declare a charge.
    - Doombolt (Warp Charge 7): Select one enemy unit that is within 24" of this model and visible to this model and (without the Lone Operative ability or that is an attached unit or within 12" of this model); unless the Psychic test result is 11+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; if the Psychic test result is 11+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.
    - Twist of Fate (Warp Charge 9): Select one enemy unit that is within 24" of this model and visible to this model (your Twist of Fate Target); until the end of the phase, each time a friendly unit attacks it, unless the Psychic test result is 12+, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 if it is made by a friendly model with the SCINTILLATING LEGIONS or THOUSAND SONS keyword; if the Psychic test result is 12+, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 if it is made by a friendly model with the SCINTILLATING LEGIONS or THOUSAND SONS keyword.

rules.name: Infernal Pacts
rules.description:
Friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units gain the Daemonic Illusions ability:
  - While a friendly PSYKER THOUSAND SONS unit is within 6" of this unit and that unit is visible to this unit, against ranged attacks, that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.
Friendly THOUSAND SONS units gain the Mortal Sorcery ability:
  - While a friendly PSYKER SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit is within 6" of this unit and that unit is visible to this unit, that unit gains the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

rules.name: Warpfire Infusion
rules.description:
Until the end of the phase:
  - When a friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability or when a friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability:
    - While the triggering unit is within 6" of a friendly PSYKER THOUSAND SONS unit:
      - You can re-roll one Hit roll.
      - You can re-roll one Wound roll.
      - You can re-roll one Damage roll.
    - While the triggering unit is not within 6" of a friendly PSYKER THOUSAND SONS unit:
      Choose one of the following:
        - You can re-roll one Hit roll.
        - You can re-roll one Wound roll.
        - You can re-roll one Damage roll.
  - When a friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model in this unit is destroyed, while the triggering unit has the Deadly Demise ability and that model is within 6" of a friendly PSYKER THOUSAND SONS unit, the threshold of this model's Deadly Demise ability is 5.

rules.name: Flow of Magic
rules.description: Your deployment zone is within Flow of Magic. At the start of each phase, if you control at least half of the objectives in no man's land, no man's land is within Flow of Magic until the end of the phase (evaluated once at that time). At the start of each phase, if you control at least half of the objectives in your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent's deployment zone is within Flow of Magic until the end of the phase (evaluated once at that time). You can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 with weapons with [PSYCHIC]. If this model is wholly within Flow of Magic, add 1 to friendly THOUSAND SONS units' Wound rolls with weapons with [PSYCHIC] instead.

rules.name: Kindred Sorcery
rules.description:
Until the start of your next Command phase:
  - At the start of your Command phase:
    - Select one (each can be chosen once per battle):
      - Imbued Manifestation: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons with [PSYCHIC] equipped by models in this unit.
      - Psychic Maelstrom: Add 1 to this unit's Wound rolls with weapons with [PSYCHIC].
      - Wrath of the Immaterium: Weapons with [PSYCHIC] equipped by models in this unit gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

rules.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice
rules.description:
Until the end of the phase:
  - When an enemy unit targets a friendly MUTANT TZEENTCH unit with the INFANTRY or MOUNTED keyword, you can use this ability:
    - If the target unit is the same unit as that unit, subtract 1 from the attacking unit's Wound rolls.
    - At the end of the phase, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
  - When a friendly MUTANT TZEENTCH unit with the INFANTRY or MOUNTED keyword is selected to shoot, you can use this ability or when a friendly MUTANT TZEENTCH unit with the INFANTRY or MOUNTED keyword is selected to fight, you can use this ability:
    - Add 1 to the triggering unit's Wound rolls.
    - At the end of the phase, the triggering unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: All is Dust
rules.description: When damage is allocated to a friendly RUBRICAE model, add 1 to this unit's saving throw rolls.

rules.name: Sorcerous Invigoration
rules.description:
Each time a friendly PSYKER THOUSAND SONS unit (excluding MONSTER units) attempts a Ritual, once per turn per unit, that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.
Applies to: THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units (excluding MONSTER units).

rules.name: Ensorcelled Animus
rules.description:
Friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS units' weapons gain [PSYCHIC].
Friendly PSYKER THOUSAND SONS units gain the Infusion ability:
  - While a friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit is within 12" of this unit, improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by that unit by 1.
Applies to: THOUSAND SONS units.

rules.name: All-Seeing Mutant Hordes
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  - Friendly TZAANGORS units gain the BATTLELINE keyword.
  - During your Shooting phase, if the attacking unit has the MUTANT keyword, add 6" to enemy units' detection range.
Applies to: THOUSAND SONS units.

    - If the triggering battle shock roll was a failure, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
